questions.questionText: Find the quotient and remainder when polynomial P(x) = 2x³ - 5x² + 4x - 7 is divided by (x - 2). [3 marks]
questions.explanation:
Remainder by Remainder Theorem: P(2) = 2(8) - 5(4) + 4(2) - 7 = 16 - 20 + 8 - 7 = -3 [1].
By long division / synthetic division: 2x³ - 5x² + 4x - 7 = (x - 2)(2x² - x + 2) - 3. Quotient = 2x² - x + 2, Remainder = -3 [2].

questions.questionText: Express (5x + 1) / [(x - 1)(x + 2)] in partial fractions. [3 marks]
Solve the logarithmic equation log₂(x + 3) + log₂(x - 1) = 5 for x > 1. [4 marks]
Find the term independent of x in the binomial expansion of (2x² - 1/x)⁹. [4 marks]
Solve 2 cos²θ + 3 sin θ - 3 = 0 for 0° ≤ θ ≤ 360°. [4 marks]
questions.explanation:
Substitute cos²θ = 1 - sin²θ: 2(1 - sin²θ) + 3 sin θ - 3 = 0 -> 2 sin²θ - 3 sin θ + 1 = 0 [1.5].
(2 sin θ - 1)(sin θ - 1) = 0 -> sin θ = 1/2 or sin θ = 1 [1].
θ = 30°, 90°, 150° [1.5].

questions.questionText: Express 3 sin θ + 4 cos θ in the form R sin(θ + α) where R > 0 and 0° < α < 90°. Hence state its maximum value. [3 marks]
questions.explanation: R = √(3² + 4²) = 5 [1]. tan α = 4/3 -> α = 53.1° [1]. Expression = 5 sin(θ + 53.1°); maximum value = 5 [1].

questions.questionText: Differentiate y = x² e^(3x) with respect to x and find the x-coordinates of stationary points. [4 marks]
questions.explanation:
Product rule: dy/dx = 2x·e^(3x) + x²·3e^(3x) = x(2 + 3x)e^(3x) [2.5].
Since e^(3x) > 0, dy/dx = 0 gives x = 0 or x = -2/3 [1.5].

questions.questionText: Find the exact value of ∫₀^(π/4) sec²(x) dx and ∫₁² (3x² + 2/x) dx. [4 marks]
Use integration by parts to evaluate ∫ x cos(2x) dx. [4 marks]
questions.explanation:
Let u = x (du = dx), dv = cos(2x) dx (v = ½ sin 2x) [1.5].
∫ x cos(2x) dx = ½x sin(2x) - ∫ ½ sin(2x) dx = ½x sin(2x) + ¼ cos(2x) + C [2.5].

questions.questionText: Find the angle between vectors a = 2i + j - 2k and b = i - 4j + 8k. [3 marks]
Complex Numbers: Given z₁ = 3 + 4i and z₂ = 1 - 2i, express z₁ / z₂ in the form a + bi. [3 marks]
Prove by Mathematical Induction that ∑_{r=1}^n r(r + 1) = n(n + 1)(n + 2) / 3 for all positive integers n. [5 marks]
questions.explanation:
Base case n=1: LHS = 1(2) = 2; RHS = 1(2)(3)/3 = 2 (holds) [1].
Inductive step: Assume true for n = k. For k + 1: k(k+1)(k+2)/3 + (k+1)(k+2) = (k+1)(k+2)[k/3 + 1] = (k+1)(k+2)(k+3)/3 [3]. Holds for n=k+1 -> proven by induction [1].

questions.questionText: A curve is defined parametrically by x = t² + 1, y = t³ - 3t. Find dy/dx in terms of t and determine the coordinates where the tangent is parallel to the x-axis. [4 marks]
questions.explanation: dx/dt = 2t, dy/dt = 3t² - 3 -> dy/dx = (3t² - 3)/(2t) [2]. Horizontal tangent when dy/dx = 0 -> 3(t² - 1) = 0 -> t = ±1 -> points (2, -2) and (2, 2) [2].

questions.questionText: Use the trapezium rule with 4 strips (5 ordinates) to approximate ∫₀² √(1 + x³) dx correct to 3 decimal places. [4 marks]
Find the Maclaurin series expansion of ln(1 + 2x) up to and including the term in x³, and state the range of x for validity. [4 marks]
questions.explanation: Using ln(1 + u) = u - u²/2 + u³/3 - ... with u = 2x: 2x - (2x)²/2 + (2x)³/3 = 2x - 2x² + (8/3)x³ [3]. Valid for -1 < 2x ≤ 1 -> -½ < x ≤ ½ [1].

questions.questionText: Solve the inequality |2x - 3| < |x + 1|. [4 marks]
questions.explanation:
Square both sides: (2x - 3)² < (x + 1)² -> 4x² - 12x + 9 < x² + 2x + 1 -> 3x² - 14x + 8 < 0 [2].
(3x - 2)(x - 4) < 0 -> critical values 2/3 and 4 -> 2/3 < x < 4 [2].

A circular ink blot grows so its radius increases at 0.2 cm/s. Find the rate at which its area is increasing when radius r = 5 cm. [3 marks]
If y = ln(sin x), find dy/dx and d²y/dx². [3 marks]
questions.explanation: dy/dx = cos x / sin x = cot x [1.5]. d²y/dx² = -cosec² x [1.5].
